title: QACI Duo playbook (SKILL.md frontmatter)
description: The YAML frontmatter of skills/<name>/SKILL.md, as checked by validatePlaybook() in scripts/lib.mjs. This schema documents that hand-written validator; scripts/lib.mjs remains the source of truth and the authoritative CI gate — this is tooling/editor documentation only. Every field is read from exactly one `key: value` line (QACI Duo's Skills library does not read YAML lists or multi-line values): a comma-separated string stands in for a JSON array below. The body below the frontmatter (not modelled here) must be 100-24000 characters and is also checked for hidden-instruction tricks (long base64-like runs, `curl | sh`, invisible Unicode). See FORMAT.md.

name.description: Must equal the folder name skills/<name>/.

triggers.description: 1-30 comma-separated phrases of at most 100 characters each (a single frontmatter line, not a YAML list).

tags.description: At most 8 comma-separated lowercase words (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,23}$ each).
